# PDF.js

This directory contains the generic browser build of [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js), version **6.5.438**.

The upstream `pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs` files are distributed under the Apache License 2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and the upstream [v6.5.438 release](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.5.438).
